en-US.description:
Quit nicotine pouches, snus, vapes and dip with a quit app that shows how much nicotine is in your body right now and predicts your next craving before it hits.

NICOTINE LEVEL & CRAVING FORECAST
• Every pouch, vape session or cigarette you log feeds a pharmacokinetic model (absorption speed per product, 2-hour half-life)
• See your estimated nicotine level live, and the curve if you skip the next one
• Nixa learns your personal craving point from your own logs and warns you a few minutes before the next craving wave
• Know exactly when your body will be nicotine-free

Nixa builds a personal step-down plan from how much you use today, then helps you through every craving until you hit zero.

STEP-DOWN PLAN
• Fewer per day each week, or lower strength first (12 → 9 → 6 → 3 mg)
• Or pick a quit day and stop completely
• Adapts weekly: tough week? add a week. Ahead? speed up

LOCK SCREEN TIMER
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island countdown to your next allowed pouch
• Log with one tap from the Lock Screen, widgets or Control Center

CRAVING SOS
• 5-minute craving wave timer
• Box breathing and 4-7-8, saved to Apple Health as Mindful Minutes
• Private coach that runs on your iPhone (Apple Intelligence on supported devices)

PROGRESS
• Money saved, nicotine avoided, time back
• Triggers and risk-hour insights, daily charts, 16 badges
• Recovery timeline and shareable cards for Stories and TikTok

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No tracking. Your data never leaves your iPhone. Face ID lock.

NIXA PRO
Monthly or yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan. Payment is charged to your Apple Account; it renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

• Coach privé qui fonctionne sur ton iPhone

Pas de compte, pas de pistage. Tes données restent sur ton iPhone. Verrouillage Face ID.

Abonnement mensuel ou annuel, 7 jours gratuits sur l'annuel. Renouvellement automatique sauf annulation au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période.
